newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen opening under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen opening under pressure.

text.p: * Toronto stocks were seen opening lower on Monday as European markets weakened after Friday's Dow drop, but analysts said losses could be limited as bulls bought into the sell-off.

Toronto stocks were expected to face downward pressure at the open on Monday as European markets weakened in response to Wall Street's Friday sell-off, but analysts said losses may be limited by bullish sentiment.

"I think we are going to open under pressure because of European weakness, but I don't think (the loss will be heavy) and we could easily end the day in positive territory," said MMS International technical analyst Katherine Beattie.
She said market bulls could use last week's sell-off as a buying opportunity.
